title: Duke Mohun Yonge
dates: (1869-1948)
---

cousin of CMY, solicitor

He was the third son of the Rev.

Duke Yonge of Puslinch and Charlotte Pode.

He married (1894) Isabella Sydney Bowen.

His elder brother Charles married her sister Catherine Ada Helena Bowen in 1899.
